YouTuber Dhruv Rathee summoned by Delhi court over 2019 case

YouTuber Dhruv Rathee has been summoned by a Saket court in Delhi in connection with a case from 2019. A hearing is scheduled for October 17. The court's order has reportedly increased Rathee's difficulties.
